changelog:
Initial public release of the stock-analysis skill.

- Provides a portable, orchestration-focused A股分析 skill for summarizing, technical indicators, context merging, LLM dashboard prompting, and report storage.
- All stock data (quotes, fundamentals, news, flows) is runtime-delegated to sibling skill a-stock-data; this skill has no internal fetchers or external dependencies.
- Supports only A 股 and A 股 ETFs; Hong Kong, US, and Taiwan stocks are not supported.
- Technical indicators and K线 implemented using the standard Python library; zero pip dependencies required.
- Offers file or sqlite report storage with customizable directories.
- Includes orchestration, prompt, and storage docs; lightweight batch signal processing enabled for up to 5 stocks at a time.
